## The architecture

![Prague Metro pipeline placeholder.](featured.svg){fig-alt="Abstract placeholder for the Prague Metro data engineering architecture" width="90%"}

The platform brings together multiple source types and processing patterns. The final case study can cover:

- Airflow orchestration and dependency management
- Object storage and versioned snapshots
- PostgreSQL staging and warehouse layers
- dbt transformations and dimensional modeling
- MongoDB and Neo4j ingestion paths
- Kafka event snapshots
- Grafana monitoring and reporting
